verdict.rationale: Aider's core interface is natural-language chat: users type instructions in plain English to edit files, ask questions, run tests, or scrape web pages, with slash-commands and a --message CLI flag also accepting NL instructions, plus voice-to-text NL input. Community reports corroborate that it responds well to natural-language prompts for codebase understanding and edits. Missing for 10: independent benchmarking of NL command robustness across edge cases, and some community reports note it can misinterpret intent (e.g., poor commit messages) or require retries, showing imperfect NL understanding.
